newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar closes flat at 476/477/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar closes flat at 476/477/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed flat at 476.00/477.00 per dollar in a quiet session that saw little Central Bank participation, traders said.
"It was a well balanced market, with matching dollar supply and dollar demand, and much the same volume traded as on Monday," said one trader.
Other traders took similar views, despite a reported intra-day trading high of 477.50 bolivars per dollar.
A similarly calm session is seen for Wednesday -- even though yields on benchmark Central Bank TEM paper are widely expected to fall at tomorrow's 20 billion bolivar TEM auction, traders said.
